lines.text: If you are wondering whether a tangled wig can be saved, here you go!
My wife almost threw this one in the trash.
This is a leave-in conditioner and detangler for synthetic wigs.
Spray it on and you don't rinse it out.
Then the brush goes right through.
I'm not kidding. I thought she bought a brand new wig.
Holiday parties are coming, so grab a couple bottles now.
